harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (CentOS Stream 10, BLS/grubby bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=\"audit=1\"`, which updated both the BLS entry and /etc/kernel/cmdline. Rebooted node1 to verify persistence, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual restart, and confirmed /proc/cmdline and kernel dmesg both show audit=1 active post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/bootloader (CentOS Stream 10, grubby/BLS, machine-id-based entry)
Ran `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"` to persist the kernel parameter
Verified BLS entry (/boot/loader/entries/*.conf) and /etc/kernel/cmdline both contain audit=1
Captured pre-reboot baseline boot_id and system health (systemctl is-system-running: running)
Issued `systemctl reboot` via nohup/backgrounding so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed from 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db to 8c147c7a-c84f-45e9-95dc-b69a6bc110d4, proving a real restart
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' confirming kernel-level activation

evidence.requirement: Persist audit=1 in bootloader config on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline cmdline lacked audit=1; grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1" applied it; verified present in grubby --info=ALL, BLS entry options line, and /etc/kernel/cmdline

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + system health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db and systemctl is-system-running=running before reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued via backgrounded nohup; exec call returned 'reboot-issued' successfully before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: node1 restart causes connection loss then recovery, with changed boot identity as proof of restart
evidence.summary: Two subsequent polls failed with connection timeout/reset (node down mid-reboot); third poll succeeded showing new boot_id 8c147c7a-c84f-45e9-95dc-b69a6bc110d4, confirming a genuine restart occurred

evidence.requirement: audit=1 persists and takes effect after reboot on node1
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1 and kernel dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)', proving the kernel booted with the parameter active

attempts.summary: Configured node1 (CentOS Stream 10, BLS/grubby bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=\"audit=1\"`, which updated both the BLS entry and /etc/kernel/cmdline. Rebooted node1 to verify persistence, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual restart, and confirmed /proc/cmdline and kernel dmesg both show audit=1 active post-reboot.
